description: An accessible way to use GitHub with NVDA: repositories, files, issues, pull requests, GitHub Actions, notifications, gists, releases and more, in fully labelled dialogs. The add-on has no default keyboard shortcuts: choose your own in NVDA menu, Preferences, Input gestures, GitHub for NVDA.
changelog: First release in this numbering. Notification checks every 15 or 30 seconds; Background announcements filter; commands to check for notifications now and to pause or resume announcements; notifications list can show only items that involve you, and can copy a link; clearer message when the token cannot read notifications; no default keyboard shortcuts, so users assign every command in Input gestures
